course.title: Product Design -II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value:
Annual surveys are performed on equipment whose operating cost per week after 13   
survey or replacement is in the following form:   
C (t) = A −B exp [-kt]   
Where A =800, B= 50, k = 0.20 and cost of replacement $( \mathbf { C } _ { \mathtt { r } } ) = \mathbb { S } 1 0 0 .$ . Determine the   
optimal replacement time between surveys.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
